name: Caldera
mood: Volcanic infrastructure on warm pumice paper, with huge compressed black headlines, ember-orange actions, violet halftone developer graphics, and sulfur signal tags.

lavaBlack.role: Primary text, logos, nav labels, icon strokes, and high-contrast borders.

obsidian.role: Dark footer panels, modal backdrops, and inverted cards.

basalt.role: Secondary dark text and deep UI surfaces.

charcoal.role: Muted text, dark border states, and disabled controls.

ash.role: Secondary body copy, captions, helper labels, and muted metadata.

stone.role: Hairline dividers, disabled borders, and quiet graphic strokes.

pumice.role: Main page background and warm neutral section surfaces.

chalk.role: Cards, inputs, light chips, and slightly raised surfaces.

steam.role: Rare white highlights and contrast text on saturated surfaces.

emberOrange.role: Primary CTA, active tags, key borders, illustration heat, and focus states.

moltenCoral.role: Hover accents and softer orange fills.

violetRift.role: Halftone hero graphics, developer nodes, and secondary action highlights.

deepViolet.role: Dark purple shadow field and contrast for violet graphics.

sulfur.role: Small tags, network badges, and notification sparks.

signalBlue.role: Rare link or network state highlight.

fallbacks.display: Arial Narrow, Helvetica Neue Condensed, Inter Tight, sans-serif

rules: Use PP Neue Montreal-style compressed sans for large display headings.
Use DM Sans for all body and UI text.
Do not use serif or monospace type unless product content requires code.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.recipe: Ember Orange fill, Lava Black or Steam text, 40px radius, DM Sans 16px/600, generous horizontal padding.

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.recipe: Transparent or Chalk fill, 1px Lava Black border, 40px radius, Lava Black text.

components.name: Rounded Card
components.recipe: Chalk or Pumice fill, 1px Lava Black or Stone border, 40px radius, 40px padding.

components.name: Hero Halftone Panel
components.recipe: Violet Rift and Deep Violet halftone geometry over Pumice or Chalk, paired with huge black headline and orange CTA.

components.name: Network Badge
components.recipe: Sulfur fill, Lava Black text, 800px radius, small DM Sans label.

components.name: Input
components.recipe: Chalk fill, Stone border, 32px radius, 16px DM Sans text, Ember focus border.

components.name: Process Diagram
components.recipe: Thin Lava Black strokes, circular nodes, occasional Violet or Ember fill, short DM Sans labels.

do: Use Pumice as the broad canvas.
Make headlines very large and tightly tracked.
Use Ember Orange as the primary action color.
Keep Violet Rift in graphic and developer-diagram contexts.
Use Sulfur only for small tags and signal marks.
dont: Do not use pure white as the main background.
Do not add extra saturated accent colors.
Do not use small 8px SaaS cards.
Do not use glassmorphism or glowing gradients.
Do not use generic blockchain coin imagery.
Do not make every accent violet.

imagery.style: Flat halftone fields, technical node diagrams, network maps, protocol illustrations, and thin black line art.
rules: Use violet halftone visuals in the hero.
Use orange and sulfur sparingly for highlights.

layout.structure: Wide 1280px centered layout with a poster-like hero, large rounded panels, warm paper sections, and oversized spacing.
layout.navigation: Simple top nav with black labels, rounded action control, and warm neutral background.
layout.sectionRhythm: Use 160px section gaps and 40px card padding.
